body: Is this saree machine-washable or dry-clean only?

answers.body: Dry-clean only, please — hand-woven thread can loosen with machine agitation. A care card is included with every order.

body: Does the blouse piece come stitched or unstitched?
Is the XL true to size for someone 6ft / 90kg?

answers.body: Yes, XL fits comfortably up to about 92kg at 6ft — the cut has a little room through the shoulders.
